name: scrum-master-toolkit
description: Scrum-vocabulary MCP server. Provides 14 tools for backlog management, sprint tracking, impediment logging, and burndown reporting.

github_token.title: GitHub Token
github_token.description: Personal access token with read/write access to the project (repo + project scopes).

config_path.title: Scrum Config Path
config_path.description: Absolute path to your project's scrum config file, e.g. /Users/you/myproject/.github/scrum/config.yml

project_root.title: Project Root
project_root.description: Absolute path to the root of the project this server manages, e.g. /Users/you/myproject
